project_type: Full-stack web app: Python FastAPI backend + React (Vite) frontend
verification_instructions: 1. Frontend: npm run build in apps/frontend (checks for syntax errors). 2. Backend: python -c 'import ast; ast.parse(open(file).read())' for each changed Python file. 3. Frontend tests: cd apps/frontend && npm run test.
setup_instructions: Backend: cd apps/backend && pip install -r requirements.txt. Frontend: cd apps/frontend && npm install.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. Python 3.11 and Node 22 available. No MongoDB or Redis running locally - use AST validation for backend.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing code patterns. Backend uses inline imports for redis (from app.db.redis import get_redis). Frontend uses axios with withCredentials. Admin auth uses httponly cookies.
key_patterns: Backend: rate limiting via _check_rate_limit with fail-closed (503). Redis accessed via lazy inline imports. JWT signing/verification via _get_signing_key()/_get_verification_key() returning (key, algorithm) tuples. Frontend: AuthContext provides token/authHeader. Admin API uses adminHeaders(token) + withCredentials:true. Analytics imported from @/utils/analytics.
directory_structure: apps/backend/app/ - FastAPI app with api/v1/ routes, models/, services/, db/. apps/frontend/src/ - React app with context/, hooks/, components/, pages/, utils/.
